claims: The 98th Academy Awards will take place on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 98th Academy Awards will air live on ABC at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT from the Dolby Theatre.
ABC is the official broadcaster for the 2026 Oscars.
Red carpet coverage for the 2026 Oscars starts at 3:30 p.m. ET on ABC and Hulu.
Streaming services for the 2026 Oscars include Hulu (including the ad-supported plan), YouTube TV, FuboTV, DIRECTV, and ABC.com (via cable login).
The 2026 Oscars are available on CTV in Canada.
The 2026 Oscars are available on ITV1 in the UK.
Conan O'Brien is the host of the 2026 Oscars.
